'''Dellalt''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].

==Geography==
Its surface was mostly covered in water, but there were three continents. The planet's [[Standard year/Legends|years]] were equal to about 1.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard]] years. The [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was slightly stronger than standard, and the days were shorter than standard. The planet was also home to the [[Swimming People of Dellalt|Dellaltians]], huge, sentient, lake dwelling reptiles. For a fee, they would ferry people and cargo across their lakes on rafts. Dellalt had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] whose light reflected on its watery surface.

==History==
The southernmost continent was the site of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] vast [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot|treasure vaults]], which were surrounded by an advanced city. According to legend, the treasure ship [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']], having escaped the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], never arrived at Dellalt, and the vaults remained empty. However, the treasure was hidden in a different set of vaults, directly below the dummy vaults. When Xim died around [[25,100 BBY]], his empire crumbled, and the city regressed considerably. Defense installations, monorails, and even the water and sewage treatment plant all crumbled into ruin.

In the mountain to the east of the town, the inbred descendants of Xim's forces knew the truth about the treasure. Known as the [[Survivors (Dellalt)|Survivors]], they maintained a thousand of Xim's still formidable war droids. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the Survivors used these droids against a group of offworlders who started a semi-legal [[J'uoch's mining camp|mining camp]] nearby.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dellalt was allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Later during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a number of Jedi and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were deployed here in a [[Battle of Dellalt|confrontation]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, at least ten Jedi including [[Siadem Forte]] and [[Klossi Anno]] fought off their former legions to escape in a [[SX troop transport|SX troop shuttle]]. Four Jedi were killed and several wounded in the stand-off and an attack by a Republic [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] and several flights of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Mission to Dellalt|discovered]] the mythical treasure of Xim the Despot.<ref name="HSatLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used Dellalt as a staging point for supplies and equipment.<ref name="TCSWE" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a ship from an Imperial convoy passing through the Dellalt system, named the ''[[Bixby]]'' [[Battle in the Dellalt system|defected]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Its crew informed the Alliance of [[Operation Strike Fear]], a major Imperial fleet operation intending to deliver critical blows to the rebels by destroying their planetary presences and bludgeoning the Rebel fleet into destruction.

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] established an outpost on the planet during their attempt to invade the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. The extragalactic aliens left the native sentient species alone, though off-world travel was prohibited.
